summary: Dragonfly Energy Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a European Patent Office notice of allowance for its dry powder coating patent covering electrode, separator, and solid-state electrolyte layers. This is a routine patent milestone, not a special situation such as M&A, restructuring, or an activist campaign. No financial terms, board action, or transaction mechanics are involved. The filing serves only as a regulatory disclosure of intellectual property progress. There is no deal to watch or risk-arb angle; the event is purely operational and non-transactional.
